messages:
Marta L: Quick status update on token-cost attribution rollup — canary running against 10% of production traffic since 09:10 PT. Basic metrics look good but we saw a small spike in tail latency (~120ms) for long-conversation traces.

Kevin R: Thanks — can you paste the query you used for the cost rollup? want to re-run locally against synthetic dataset.

Marta L: Sure, here's the aggregation we used (simplified):
```sql
SELECT model, date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, SUM(tokens*price_per_token) AS cost
FROM token_events
WHERE env = 'canary'
GROUP BY model, hour;
```

Samir P: Re: tail latency — looks like it's the prefix cache miss path. I'm seeing extra KV loads when sequence_length > 2048. Can you share the event sample schema that triggers that?

Marta L: Pasted a minimal example of the event we're ingesting:
```json
{
  "user_id": "u-123",
  "model": "redwood/rlhf-13b",
  "tokens": 13456,
  "seq_len": 3072,
  "route": "hosted",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-15T16:09:00Z"
}
```

Elaine C: Ownership/next steps check: who owns the schema change rollback if we need it? currently the producers are analytics-ingest (Samir) and the consumer is cost-rollup (Marta).

Samir P: I can own producer-side gating — I'll add a feature flag on the ingest path and a schema-compat check. ETA today EOD.

Marta L: I'll own the consumer-side fallback to previous rollup code and pin canary % if we need to throttle. PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cost-rollup/pull/712 (small refactor + metrics).

Kevin R: Quick code-review ping on that PR — left two small comments about null handling and a missing index hint.

Marta L: Got them, will patch in the morning. Also note: we need an alarms page update — cost-rollup svc should escalate to eng-oncall if per-hour cost delta > 15% AND token ingestion rate > 10k/s.

Elaine C: I'll add an ops runbook entry and an alert in Datadog. ETA tomorrow morning.

infra-bot: Canary traffic flipped to 10% at 2026-02-15T09:10:12Z by @Marta L — build/sha abc123

Samir P: One more dependency: the telemetry schema change requires a minor mapping in the telemetry ETL (PR to come). If anyone needs to validate sample events, I put a replay script in infra-tools: `scripts/replay_events.sh --sample 1000 --env canary`.

Kevin R: Re: validation — I'll run the replay against my local cost-rollup and send a short result summary. If we see >1% mismatch in model attribution we hold the canary.

Marta L: Plan for tomorrow: (1) Samir lands producer gating + replay script, (2) Kevin validates and posts mismatch metrics, (3) Elaine updates alerts and runbook, (4) I patch PR and monitor canary for 12h before increasing traffic.

Elaine C: Sounds good. tagging @eng-oncall leads in case we need an immediate rollback. :thumbsup:

Kevin R: Thanks all, I'll post results in this thread when done.

Marta L: FYI — added a short smoke-check list to the PR description (load test, key cardinality check, per-model delta table). If anyone wants to add checks, comment on the PR.

Samir P: I'll add the schema-compat unit test.

Marta L: Closing the loop here for now — will update thread when we decide to expand canary. Appreciate the quick responses. :raised_hands:
